title: Raw model output record (one JSONL line, append-only)

backend.description: String (normalized) or raw infer.py object {name, base_url, model, model_revision, response_model, ...}.

model_revision.description: Exact revision/commit or weight file SHA-256

latency_s.description: Seconds. Aliases accepted by the harness: latency_seconds (raw infer.py), latency, latency_ms.

error.description: Non-null excludes the item: reason incomplete_output when it marks an empty or length-cut answer (infer.py type incomplete, 'No final answer text'), otherwise inference_error. normalize_outputs.py serialises error objects to JSON strings.

finish_reason.description: Optional; 'length' flags truncated_output. Also read from raw_response.choices[0].

provider_raw_response.description: normalize_outputs.py: full provider JSON; ignored by grading.

retrieval_evidence.description: normalize_outputs.py: retrieved chunk ids from prepare_rag.py; NOT credited as model citations.

retrieval_index_sha256.description: normalize_outputs.py: retrieval index hash from the trace.

notes: Inline citations in raw_response use [[source_id#locator]]; the claim is the enclosing sentence.
